dispositions.disposition: Fixed: compatibility is checked inside each write lease; the minimum writer is claimed monotonically before repairs/migrations. Concurrency and failed-claim tests plus data R3 verify these paths.

Recorded architecture limits in 03 section 3.1: schema initialization predates the guard; older schemas can drop newer local tables; local-to-synced transition needs explicit migration planning in 0.5.0. No sync added.

First-ever install cannot identify a prior version; update return keeps existing navigation behavior. Reopen/search navigation improvements remain filed field follow-ups. The explicit 0.4.0 to 0.4.1 test checks the notice.

Classified selector/navigation mistakes separately from WebKit offline emulation/page-navigation tooling failures. Exact form selectors and two same-context pages match the UI. Origin-unreachable negative controls replace broken offline emulation, with unchanged assertion/time limits.
